scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml docs/node_modules docs/.quasar docs/dist icons/node_modules
scripts.build: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.format: oxfmt --ignore-path .oxfmtignore .github docs icons/build icons/package.json netlify.toml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check --ignore-path .oxfmtignore .github docs icons/build icons/package.json netlify.toml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:smoke
